description: Interactive graph of collateral and wrapper dependencies between stablecoins. Node size reflects market cap; lines show direct dependency links.
title: Dependency Map
lead: See hidden systemic risk: the live graph of who backs whom.
headerSupplement: This graph maps direct collateral and wrapper dependencies between stablecoins. Select a coin to inspect its upstream assets and direct dependents, or use it as an Exposure root to trace linked coins.

lens.scope: Node size reflects market cap, not a forecast of losses. Exposure mode finds mapped downstream dependents using supply at publication evaluation. A dependency link identifies a relationship, not an outcome.

faq.question: What does the Dependency Map show?
faq.answer: The Dependency Map shows direct collateral and wrapper dependencies between stablecoins with published Safety Scores. Bridges, custodians, and other shared infrastructure are not drawn as separate nodes.

faq.question: Why can dependency risk matter even when a coin holds its peg?
faq.answer: An upstream collateral asset, bridge, issuer, or shared contract can transmit changes to a dependent coin before a price depeg appears. Exposure mode traces mapped relationships, not the outcome of a failure.

faq.question: How should I combine this with Safety Scores?
faq.answer: Use the map to trace collateral and wrapper relationships, then read each coin's grade and dependency inputs on Safety Scores.

exposure.description: Find coins linked to these upstream assets through mapped collateral and wrapper relationships. This does not estimate losses or changes in Safety Scores.
